title: Catalog Year Rights Conflict After Articulation Agreement Revision
scenario_text:
**Banner SIS — Student Record (ID: BSU-2022-11087)**
Name: Maria Elena Gutierrez-Soto | Admit Term: Fall 2022 | Type: Transfer from Mt. Hood CC
Catalog Year: 2022-23 | Major: BA Psychology | Credits Earned: 94 | GPA: 3.41
Expected Graduation: Spring 2026 | Enrollment: Continuous (no breaks)

**DegreeWorks — Degree Audit (generated Jun 15, 2026)**
Status: NOT CLEARED FOR GRADUATION
Deficiency: PSY 410 (Research Methods) — Required, not completed
Note: "PSY 210 (Intro Research Methods — Mt. Hood CC) was previously mapped as equivalent. Equivalency removed per articulation agreement v5 (effective Fall 2024). Student must complete PSY 410 or file substitution petition."

**Google Drive — "Articulation Agreements" folder**
File: MtHoodCC_Psychology_v4.pdf (effective 2020-2024)
  → Section 3.2: "PSY 210 at MHCC satisfies PSY 410 prerequisite AND partial equivalency (lab component waived if GPA > 3.0)"
File: MtHoodCC_Psychology_v5.pdf (effective Fall 2024)
  → Section 3.2: "PSY 210 at MHCC satisfies prerequisite only. Full equivalency discontinued — lab methodology component no longer aligns with revised PSY 410 learning outcomes."

**Google Chat — Faculty DM between Dr. Leah Morrison (Psych Chair) and Dr. James Whitfield (Jun 2, 2026)**
Morrison: Jim — we have 6 students caught in the artic agreement change for PSY 410. They had equivalency under v4 but DegreeWorks stripped it when we loaded v5.
Whitfield: Wasn't there supposed to be a teach-out provision? I thought we agreed in curriculum committee that anyone admitted under v4 would be held harmless.
Morrison: That's what I recall too. But I can't find it in the minutes. Karen took notes but she went on sabbatical.
Whitfield: Check the Canvas shell for the curriculum committee — she used to post draft minutes there before they went to Faculty Senate.
:thumbsup: [Morrison reacted]

**Canvas LMS — "Curriculum Committee 2023-24" course shell (unpublished)**
Announcement (posted Nov 14, 2023, by Karen Ostrowski): "Draft minutes from 11/8 meeting attached. Please review before I submit to Senate."
Attachment: CurrComm_Minutes_Nov8_2023.docx
Content excerpt: "Motion 23-14: Articulation agreement revisions for MHCC Psychology pathway. Approved 7-2. AMENDMENT (friendly, accepted): Students admitted under v4 with continuous enrollment retain v4 equivalencies through graduation. No sunset date."

**Banner — Catalog/Curriculum module**
PSY 410 course record: Last modified Sep 2024. Learning outcomes revised. Lab component now mandatory (4 cr → 5 cr effective Fall 2024).
Note: No teach-out provision coded. DegreeWorks exception table: Empty for PSY 410/MHCC equivalency.

**Slate (Admissions) — Transfer Evaluation Record**
Evaluator notes (Aug 2022): "PSY 210 — mapped per artic agreement v4. Equivalency: PSY 410. Confirmed with dept."
question: Should Maria Elena Gutierrez-Soto be cleared for graduation without completing PSY 410, and what is the authoritative basis for the decision?

contributor.name: Michael Owusu
contributor.title: Associate Registrar
contributor.domain_expertise: Enrollment verification, transfer credit evaluation, academic policy interpretation, FERPA compliance, degree audit exceptions

choices: No — the current articulation agreement (v5) governs, and DegreeWorks correctly removed the equivalency. She must complete PSY 410 or petition for a substitution through the standard process.
No — while the curriculum committee discussed a teach-out, the motion was never submitted to Faculty Senate (Karen went on sabbatical), so it lacks institutional authority. The student must petition.

Yes — catalog year rights mean the 2022-23 catalog governs all of her degree requirements, and since the equivalency existed when she was admitted, it cannot be retroactively revoked under any circumstances.

Yes — the curriculum committee motion 23-14 with its accepted amendment constitutes an approved teach-out provision; her continuous enrollment and v4 catalog year entitle her to the original equivalency regardless of the DegreeWorks configuration.
